_doc: REL-RUNTIME-PINS (F-047, DEP-06, decision 0063). Hash pins for the runtimes of an installed copy, fetched at install time by the installer's own process (server/al/pinfetch.py ensure_runtime) from their publishers, never bundled, never vendored and never fetched by the running core. python: the embeddable CPython zip at the exact version, size and SHA-256 below; url, size and sha256 were re-read from www.python.org (the zip downloaded with the AshLight User-Agent and hashed) on the verified date. electron: one source, the pin of config/electron_pin.json (OVL-ELECTRON-PIN); only its licence is recorded here. A missing or malformed value makes the fetch refuse; never guess one. No absolute paths here.
